backlogItem.notReady: Only Product Backlog items refined to READY can enter a Sprint. {{count}} selected item(s) are not READY yet: {{items}}.

backlogOrder.duplicateItems: A reorder cannot name the same Product Backlog item twice.
backlogOrder.empty: A reorder must name at least one Product Backlog item.
backlogOrder.incompleteList: A full reorder must contain every item of the team's Product Backlog: expected {{expected}}, received {{received}}. To reorder a filtered view, send a positional move (pbiId, targetPbiId, position) instead.
backlogOrder.multipleTeams: All reordered items must belong to the same team's Product Backlog.
backlogOrder.productOwnerOnly: Only the Product Owner orders the Product Backlog: changing an item's MoSCoW priority or its position is the Product Owner's decision.
backlogOrder.selfMove: An item cannot be moved before or after itself.
backlogOrder.tooMany: A reorder cannot contain more than {{max}} Product Backlog items.

developerOnlySizing: Only Developers can set story points, as the Developers who perform the work are responsible for sizing.
dodNotVerified: This item cannot be marked Done until every active Definition of Done item is verified. {{count}} active item(s) still need verification.
dodRequired: Nothing is Done until the team has defined what Done means, so a Definition of Done must keep at least one active item. An empty checklist would let every item be marked Done unchecked.
dodTeamMembersOnly: The Definition of Done is the Scrum Team's own agreement about what "Done" means: only a member of that team can read or change it.
emailAlreadyExists: An account with email {{email}} already exists
forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action

impediment.deleteForbidden: Only the person who reported an impediment, its owner, or the Scrum Master can delete it. The record of what held the team back is evidence.
impediment.invalidTargetDate: A target date must be a valid ISO date, for example 2026-05-15.
impediment.ownerNotTeamMember: An impediment can only be owned by a member of the team it was raised for.
impediment.sprintNotOfTeam: An impediment can only be linked to a Sprint of the team it was raised for.
impediment.teamMembersOnly: The impediment belongs to its Scrum Team: only a member of that team can read or change it.
impediment.terminalResolutionRequired: Reaching a resolved or closed state requires a written resolution. State how the impediment was removed, so closing it cannot lift the Sprint-close gate without evidence.

increment.alreadyDelivered: This Increment has already been delivered and cannot be delivered again.
increment.deliveredLocked: This Increment has been delivered or archived and can no longer be changed.
increment.deliveryRequiresMethod: An Increment is recorded as delivered through the deliver action, which captures how it reached users. Record the delivery method instead of writing the status directly.
increment.integrationRequired: This Increment cannot be verified or delivered until its integration with every prior Increment has passed. Record the required integration tests first.
increment.pbisNotOfTeam: Every item an Increment contains must belong to this team's Product Backlog.
increment.sprintNotOfTeam: An Increment can only be composed from a Sprint of the team that owns it.
increment.teamMembersOnly: The Increment belongs to its Scrum Team: only a member of that team can read, verify, or deliver it.
increment.usabilityRequired: This Increment cannot be verified or delivered before its usable condition is attested in writing. Record the usability evidence first.

notTeamMember: You are not a member of this team
pleaseLoginAgain: Please log in again to continue

productGoal.abandonmentReasonRequired: Abandoning a Product Goal requires a reason so the team can inspect why the objective was dropped.
productGoal.alreadyActive: An active Product Goal already exists for this team. Fulfil or abandon it before activating another.
productGoal.evidenceRequired: A Product Goal cannot be completed without evidence. Record a Sprint Review assessment or measured success-metric values for this goal first.
productGoal.notActive: A backlog item can only be linked to the team's active Product Goal. Activate this goal, or link the item to the goal that is active.
productGoal.productOwnerOnly: Only the Product Owner can create, edit, or delete a Product Goal.
productGoal.requiredForBacklog: The Product Backlog is the emergent expression of the Product Goal. Define an active Product Goal before adding backlog items.
productGoal.snapshotEvidenceRequired: A Product Goal snapshot must record what the team inspected: provide an assessment or the measured success-metric values.
productGoal.successMetricsRequired: A Product Goal must declare at least one success metric: state how the team will know the future state has been reached.

reports.teamMembersOnly: A report reads a team's own observed history -- what it committed to, delivered, and inspected. Transparency in Scrum is visibility to those doing and receiving the work, not to the whole installation, so only a member of that team can read its reports.

retrospective.actionItemLinked: This improvement is already carried by the Product Backlog item "{{title}}", so it counts as addressed. Remove the link before marking it unaddressed.
retrospective.dodChangesMissing: The Retrospective recorded no Definition of Done reflection, so there is nothing to apply. Inspect at least one criterion first.
retrospective.smNotesSmOnly: The Scrum Master's notes are coaching observations about the Sprint Retrospective, so only the team's Scrum Master can read or write them.
retrospective.teamMembersOnly: The Sprint Retrospective is its Scrum Team's own event and holds candid reflection about individuals and interactions, so only a member of that team can read or change it.

roleAlreadyTaken: A {{role}} already exists for this team. Each team can have exactly one {{role}}.

sprint.cancelRequiresProductOwner: Only the Product Owner can cancel a Sprint
sprint.capacityExceeded: The Sprint cannot be started: the planned work ({{planned}}h) exceeds the recorded capacity ({{capacity}}h) by more than the allowed tolerance of {{tolerance}}%. Reduce the plan or record more capacity first.
sprint.changeNeedsPo: Only the Product Owner can acknowledge a Sprint Backlog change that endangers the Sprint Goal.
sprint.changeNotPending: This Sprint Backlog change is not awaiting acknowledgement (status: {{status}}).
sprint.datesOverlap: The Sprint dates overlap an existing Sprint ({{sprintName}}). A team cannot run two Sprints at the same time.
sprint.durationLimit: The Sprint cannot be created: its span of {{days}} days exceeds the one-month maximum of {{max}} days. Shorten the Sprint to one month or less.
sprint.goalLocked: The Sprint Goal is a commitment once a Sprint is running and cannot be edited afterwards. Revise it through the Product Owner's acknowledgement of a Sprint Backlog change that endangers it.
sprint.impedimentsUnresolved: The Sprint cannot be completed while it still has unresolved impediments: {{impediments}}. Resolve or close them before closing the Sprint.
sprint.invalidDateRange: The Sprint's end date must be after its start date.
sprint.missingGoal: The sprint cannot be started without a Sprint Goal
sprint.notContiguous: A new Sprint must start immediately after the previous one concludes: the gap to "{{sprintName}}" is larger than the {{max}} days allowed for the intervening weekend. Adjust the dates so no Sprint-less time is left between them.
sprint.notPlanned: Only planned sprints can be started
sprint.notReadyToStart: The Sprint Backlog must be saved before the sprint can be started
sprint.notReplannable: Only a Sprint that is still being planned (DRAFT or PLANNED) can be updated. This Sprint is in status {{status}}.
sprint.participationRequired: The Sprint cannot be started without recorded planning participation. Record attendance that includes the Product Owner and at least one Developer.
sprint.pbiAlreadyCommitted: Backlog item "{{pbiTitle}}" is already committed to another sprint ({{sprintName}}). A Product Backlog Item can be worked in only one sprint at a time.
sprint.pbiConflictAtStart: The Sprint cannot be started: the following backlog items are already committed to another sprint: {{items}}.
sprint.prerequisiteEventsMissing: The Sprint cannot be completed because the following event(s) have not concluded: {{events}}. Record them before closing the Sprint.
sprint.productGoalRequired: The Sprint cannot be started without a linked Product Goal. Link the Sprint to the team's Product Goal first.
sprint.scopeChangeAlreadyPending: A change to this item that endangers the Sprint Goal is already awaiting the Product Owner's acknowledgement. Resolve it before requesting another.
sprint.scopeGoalRenegotiationRequired: Approving a change that endangers the Sprint Goal requires the renegotiated Sprint Goal, so the team knows what it is now working toward.
sprint.scopeReasonRequired: Every Sprint Backlog change must record why it is being made.
sprint.teamMembersOnly: The Sprint belongs to its Scrum Team: only a member of that team can create, start, or replan it.

sprintBacklog.capacityNotOfTeam: Every capacity entry must belong to a Developer on this team.
sprintBacklog.developersOnly: Only Developers can save the Sprint Backlog, as the Developers who perform the work own the Sprint Backlog.
sprintBacklog.pbiNotOfTeam: Every item selected for a Sprint must belong to this team's Product Backlog.

sprintReview.eventBeforeEndDate: The Sprint Review inspects the outcome of the Sprint and the Sprint Retrospective concludes it, so neither can be completed before the Sprint's end date ({{endDate}}).
sprintReview.goalOutcomeNotApplicable: This Sprint has no Sprint Goal, so there is nothing to assess. Attainment is a verdict about a Goal the team committed to.
sprintReview.goalOutcomeRequired: The Sprint Review is where the team discusses progress toward the Sprint Goal, so completing this Review requires the team's own verdict on it: achieved, partially achieved, or not achieved. Item completion is not a substitute -- a Sprint can meet its Goal without completing every item, and complete every item without meeting its Goal.
sprintReview.retrospectiveRequiresReview: The Sprint Review is the second-to-last event of the Sprint and the Sprint Retrospective concludes the Sprint. Complete the Sprint Review before completing the Retrospective.
sprintReview.smNotesSmOnly: The Scrum Master's notes are coaching observations about the Sprint Review, so only the team's Scrum Master can write them.
sprintReview.teamMembersOnly: The Sprint Review is its Scrum Team's own event: only a member of that team can record attendance, leave feedback, adjust the Product Backlog, or complete it.

task.assigneeMustBeDeveloper: Only Developers on the team can be assigned. Product Owners and Scrum Masters cannot assign tasks.
task.creationRequiresDeveloper: Only Developers can create and decompose tasks, as the Developers who perform the work own task decomposition.

teamSizeLimitReached: This team has reached the maximum size of {{max}} members. No additional members can be added.
